scientific.integrity: The proof is an exact pointwise comparison of the source remainder weights combined with the published seed-interval theorems. No numerical experiment, inaccessible lemma, or independence claim is used.
scientific.limitations: The result establishes positivity for every positive remainder exponent and monotonicity of the best constants, but it does not determine their sharp numerical values, a uniform-in-parameter lower bound, or analogous statements for differently shaped remainder weights.

title: All positive \(\tau\) are admissible in the fractional half-space Hardy–Maz’ya remainders
